Update5 March 2026·All news·Original post on aa-classic.com
Patch Notes - Mar 5, 2026
Siege prep changes: castles need 50 members in the top 50 rankings; trainee duration now 5 days; new Reinforced Ironclad (wrapped, siege-only, tougher vs siege damage). Archery Endless Arrows reworked for early gear scaling; Performing Quickstep gains Lightning ancestral Double-Time. Morpheus quest wording +30% duel radius.

📜 Patch Notes - Mar 5, 2026

🏰 Sieges

  • The bidding requirements have been adjusted to: 50 members, top 50 rankings (from 50 members, top 20 rankings)
  • The Trainee rank duration is now 5 days (from 7) 👉 This is already the case, but writing it in here.
  • A new Siege vehicle has been added: Reinforced Ironclad
    • Crafted as a Wrapped item. Lasts 90 minutes once unwrapped.
    • Can only be used by Siege Participants
    • Receives decreased Magic, Melee and Ranged damage (compared to Ironclad)
    • Receives increased Siege damage (compared to Ironclad)
    • Same damage output as a standard Ironclad## Skills
  • Skill [Endless Arrows] has a new damage scaling function
    • More flat damage, less scaling damage up to ~1200 ranged attack
    • Current damage formula above 1200 ranged attack
  • Skill: [Perform: Quickstep] now has a Lightning Ancestral variant: [Double-Time]
    • [Double-Time] is a self-cast buff. It lasts 2 seconds and increases the caster's movespeed gradually up to 200%.
    • 28 seconds cooldown## Misc.
  • The requirements for [Nachen's Vengeance] has been changed from killing Morpheus to defeating Morpheus.
  • Duel range has been increased by 30% to accomodate gliders/mount dashes

== 📜 Patch Notes - Mar 5, 2026 ==

== 🏰 Sieges ==

* The bidding requirements have been adjusted to: 50 members, top 50 rankings (from 50 members, top 20 rankings)
* The Trainee rank duration is now 5 days (from 7) 👉 This is already the case, but writing it in here.
* A new Siege vehicle has been added: Reinforced Ironclad
** Crafted as a Wrapped item. Lasts 90 minutes once unwrapped.
** Can only be used by Siege Participants
** Receives decreased Magic, Melee and Ranged damage (compared to Ironclad)
** Receives increased Siege damage (compared to Ironclad)
** Same damage output as a standard Ironclad## [[File:News emojis-1253872084040286270.png|500px|link=|alt=ChainLightning]] Skills
* Skill [Endless Arrows] has a new damage scaling function
** More flat damage, less scaling damage up to ~1200 ranged attack
** Current damage formula above 1200 ranged attack
* Skill: [Perform: Quickstep] now has a Lightning Ancestral variant: [Double-Time]
** [Double-Time] is a self-cast buff. It lasts 2 seconds and increases the caster's movespeed gradually up to 200%.
** 28 seconds cooldown## Misc.
* The requirements for [Nachen's Vengeance] has been changed from killing Morpheus to defeating Morpheus.
* Duel range has been increased by 30% to accomodate gliders/mount dashes
